material_findings: OptiMer makes mixture selection a post-hoc distribution-vector optimization and reports 2.1-6.7 points over uniform DataMix with 15-35x lower ratio-search time in its tested Gemma-3-27B setting.
OptiMer has not been compared head-to-head with DoReMi/RegMix at 27B; its own limitations explicitly preserve this gap.
Current official OptiMer code leaves Optuna/Python RNG unseeded by default and uses defaults that differ from the paper's Table-1 search contract.
Data Mixing Agent acquisition is 384 trajectories, 50M proxy models, 27,266 feedbacks and 1996.08 GPU-hours; its 52-vs-54 domain-space wording is internally inconsistent.
